title: Sample EPA (edit me)
description: Replace this with the actual Entrustable Professional Activity you are assessing — e.g. its title, the clinical/professional task it covers, and the context in which it is observed (setting, patient population, typical complexity). Everything in this file (data/epas.json) is meant to be edited to match your own program's EPAs; you can add as many EPA entries to this array as you need.

levels.1: Learner may observe the activity only. Does not perform any part of the task hands-on, even with a supervisor directly present and guiding every step.
levels.2: Learner performs the activity with a supervisor physically present in the room, actively directing and coaching through each step in real time (direct supervision).
levels.3a: Learner performs the activity with a supervisor immediately available nearby (not necessarily in the room) who proactively checks in at key points (indirect supervision, supervisor proactively engaged).
levels.3b: Learner performs the activity with a supervisor available on request (e.g. by phone or page) but not proactively checking in; supervisor is reactively available if the learner asks (indirect supervision, supervisor reactively available).
levels.4: Learner performs the activity independently, without a supervisor needing to be immediately available (unsupervised practice).
levels.5: Learner is entrusted to supervise or teach more junior learners performing the activity, and can recognize when others need to be pulled back to a lower level of supervision.
